name: Score Card Teaser
blurb: A sports-broadcast style rating card: the B-roll plays big on the left, a score panel on the right fills with categories pulled from the VO (QUALITY, PRICE, FIT...) whose bars spin like slot reels and stop on '?' to tease the verdict; on the turn the panel flips gold and the bars fill; a ticker crawls along the bottom with the key words; the title sits on the final OVERALL score card.
off_why: dhgate watchb spread 2026-10-24: 'it's okay, but it's not moving ... this template still is like not alive' (B-roll boxed on the left, score panel + ticker take half the frame)
